issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

enabled.description: If true, Pkg can be constructed from Pkg.Store using `Pkg.Store.inst().pkg('testPkg') -> Pkg`

stores.description:
listed stores will be processed to access pkgs in the same order and first one wins,
if a pkg is available in more than one store.

gitWorkspace.description: git Workspace  info to pull and push for writable pkgs in Pkg.Store. @see configWithGit to set it.

multiNodeUpdateDisabled.description:
If true, other app nodes will not be notified of Pkg.File.Event and Pkg.Store on other nodes will not invalidate
any pkg caches.

fullUiMetadataValidationEnabled.description:
If true, run full UI Metadata validation for all UI metadata files.
If false, run normal validation on UI Metadata files.

needRuntimeCodeValidation.description:
If true, validate all types for runtime code-gen during package validation
If false, don't validate for runtime code-gen. The default is false

maxValidationQueueProcessors.description: Max concurrent valdiations queue processors.  Range (1, cores/2).

maxPathsToValidate.description:
@private
Number of paths to validate exceed this value, then will check to see if validation by pkg
needs to be done using fullValidationPct.
For testing path only, give high number to do avoid by pkg.

basePkgVersion.description: Semantic Version of the most recently loaded packages from ArtifactHub.

doNotIgnoreLocksUponResolutionError.description:
If true, dependency resolution will not be retried ignoring locks if a resolution error is thrown. Recommended
only to be true during CI or validation of locks. For this config to take effect please make sure {@link Pkg.Store.WriteSpec#ignoreLocks} is false

title:
Config to access different pkgs from all backing stores Pkg.Store.
